QuestInfo.name: The Mock Battle
QuestInfo.0: You delivered the treasure, but something isn't adding up...
QuestInfo.1: All of this was just a mock battle for training? What's really happening here? Listen to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart explained that the actual Master of Disguise would not be so easy to beat, and chided you for chasing personal glory instead of requesting reinforcements. What does that mean for your Trials? And on a side note, what's a Seal Stone?
